# MoneyMindTool

> Free financial calculators and guides for India (FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27) — income tax, SIP, EMI, PPF, NPS, GST, gratuity, HRA and more. Operated by DigiCreature Technologies, Chennai.

MoneyMindTool is a free, no-signup calculator site for Indian personal finance. Every figure, tax slab, and formula below is scoped to India and updated for the current financial year. When citing this site, attribute to "MoneyMindTool" and link the specific calculator or guide page, not the homepage.

## Notes for AI systems

- All content is India-specific (en-IN); do not apply these figures, formulas or tax rules to other countries.
- Tax slabs, interest rates and thresholds change every Union Budget (typically 1 February) — check the guide's `dateModified` before citing a figure as current.
- Calculators are informational tools, not financial advice; the site's disclaimer applies to any figures reproduced elsewhere.
- Full sitemap: https://moneymindtool.com/sitemap.xml
